cohort: Women with MNM criteria as defined by the WHO, Namibian, and SSA tools during a one-year period (March 2017-February 2018) in Suriname, with hospital births used as a reference group.
finding: The WHO MNM tool underestimated MNM prevalence in Suriname (high mortality index), while adapted tools (Namibian and SSA) may overestimate MNM and compromise global comparability.
